$comentario: App Expo/React Native. Node cobre lint/tipos/jest; mobile-static roda expo-doctor; mobile-android compila APK e roda Maestro no emulador. Os ids correspondem a testID nos componentes.

android.buildCommand: npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease

ios.buildCommand: npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Release -derivedDataPath ios/build
